templates.name: Work-email code
templates.trigger: Sent when a referrer requests a one-time code. 6 digits, 10-minute expiry, 5 attempts.
templates.subject: Your skipwait.me verification code
body: Your skipwait.me verification code is ⟨6-digit code⟩. It expires in 10 minutes and works once.
If you did not request it, ignore this email - nothing changes.

templates.name: Password reset
templates.trigger: Sent when someone asks to reset a password. Neutral reply: always “check your email”, whether the account exists or not. 1-hour single-use link.
templates.subject: Reset your skipwait.me password
body: You asked to reset your skipwait.me password. This link works for 1 hour, once: ⟨reset link⟩
If you did not ask for this, ignore this email — nothing changes. Passwords are managed through secure sign-in; you can also continue with email from the sign-in page.

templates.name: Welcome
templates.trigger: Sent after first sign-in with the honest next step for the account type.

templates.name: Request claimed
templates.trigger: A verified employee claims a pending referral request. Seeker sees company domain only.
templates.subject: Your referral request was claimed — ⟨company⟩
body: A verified employee at ⟨company⟩ claimed your private referral request.

templates.name: Referral accepted
templates.trigger: A referrer accepts. Messaging opens; identities follow the accept rules.
templates.subject: Your referral was accepted — ⟨company⟩
body: A verified employee at ⟨company⟩ accepted your private referral request.

templates.name: Referral passed
templates.trigger: A referrer passes. The referral request stays active for other employees; the slot is not freed.
templates.subject: Update on your referral request — ⟨company⟩
body: Your request at ⟨company⟩ remains visible to other verified employees.

templates.name: New message
templates.trigger: A private message arrives in an accepted conversation.

templates.name: Waiting for coverage
templates.trigger: A referral request has no verified employees available yet at the company.

templates.name: Slot opened
templates.trigger: A referrer opens capacity and waiting referral requests become reviewable.
templates.subject: Private referral review available at ⟨company⟩
body: A referral review is now available at ⟨company⟩
A verified employee opened review capacity for your private request. This does not guarantee an introduction, interview, or hiring outcome.

templates.name: Review ready
templates.trigger: A private review link is prepared for a verified employee. Never includes candidate content.
templates.subject: Private referral review at ⟨company⟩
body: A private review is ready at ⟨company⟩
Reviewing is optional and never costs you anything. Sign in with your verified company email before any decision is recorded.
Opening this link never records a decision. Review and confirm on skipwait.me.

templates.name: Re-verify reminder
templates.trigger: A work-email verification approaches its re-check window.

templates.name: Report outcome
templates.trigger: A safety report the user filed reaches resolved or dismissed.
body: Our safety team reviewed your report and took action. Thank you for flagging it.

templates.name: Payment receipt / failed
templates.trigger: A credit purchase or subscription event confirms — or a payment fails with next steps.
